definitions.full: H6877. tseriach צְרִיחַ noun [masculine] perhaps excavation, underground chamber ; — ׳צ absolute Judg 9:49 , construct 9:46 ; plural צְרִחִים 1Sam 13:6 ; — used as hiding-places 13:6 (+ בֹּרוֺת סְלָעִים, חֲוָחִים, מְעָרוֺת, ); as refuge Judg 9:46 (where connected with shrine), 9:49 (Vrss stronghold ; on uncertainty of meaning see GFM). צֹרִי see I. צֹר . צְרֻיָה צְרִי, צֳרִי, see צרה . above, צרך (√ of following; Late Hebrew צָרַךְ have need of ; Arabic be needy , so Aramaic צְרַךְ , ( צ , = !); Christian-Palestinian Aramaic χρεία ).
